Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Removed the redundant Report flag from DJ List cards (still available on the full profile page). A card going LIVE NOW no longer shifts its Like/View buttons compared to its neighbors. Fixed a small gap of bare background showing between an avatar photo and its own colored frame.
